thread:
Jordan: Heads-up: FinBank wants a BYO-KMS POC. Requirements they listed: key material must never leave their HSM (FIPS), PKCS#11 or CloudHSM handshake, signed PoP on onboarding, 90-day rotation, 7y audit retention. Ask: timeline + delta vs hosted pricing. Starting coordination here.

Maya: Got it. We support BYO via VPC tunnel for CloudHSM and a VPN for on-prem HSMs. Need to confirm whether they expect Redwood to ever hold any unwrapped key material or only wrapped keys provided by them.

Priya: From InfoSec: our default is zero-knowledge. Envelope encryption where their root key stays in their HSM and we only hold ciphertext. For PoP we need an HSM-signed nonce or attestation we can validate. Also we need vendor cert chain and attestation format (PKCS#11 sig vs vendor attestation blob). Legal will require the chain.

Luca: Pricing: BYO POC has a one-time integration/setup fee. Ballpark for POC engineering + ops: $8k-15k depending on on-prem complexity. Audit retention addon (7y) is extra; estimate $2k/month. If they take Dedicated or SLA, that's separate monthly commit. Will draft SOW items once scope confirmed.

Maya: Ops checklist (high level):
- Network: allow egress from our infra to customer's PKCS#11 endpoint / CloudHSM; if on-prem, customer must open VPN or SSH tunnel endpoints for our egress IPs.
- Auth: mTLS for HSM handshake + API tokens for control plane.
- Logging: option to forward logs to customer SIEM or keep encrypted audit blobs stored in Redwood with retention addon.

Maya: Minimal config example we can share: 
```
kms_provider: "pkcs11"
endpoint: "hsm.finbank.local:8080"
auth:
  client_cert: "/etc/redwood/certs/finbank-client.pem"
  client_key: "/etc/redwood/keys/finbank-client.key"
key_handling: "customer_root_in_hsm"
rotation: 90d
attestation_required: true
```

Jordan: They want a signed PoP within 24h of kickoff (signed nonce). Also concerned about rotation causing downtime. Can we support seamless rollovers?

Priya: Yes. We can do staged key versions and a rolling swap: create new key version in their HSM, update routing to prefer new key while keeping old key as fallback for 7-14 days. We'll adjust prefix cache TTLs and do canary traffic. Need vendor certs to verify PoP signature. Also clarify whether they need FIPS 140-2 or 140-3 attestation.

Maya: Two items we need from the customer to unblock setup: 1) HSM vendor + attestation docs (e.g., nCipher / Thales / AWS CloudHSM), 2) network egress ranges we should use (we'll provide exact IPs once infra schedules it).

deploy-bot: ticket created INC-2026 BYO-KMS-POC-REQ assigned to @Maya priority P2 ETA 2024-05-09

Luca: Draft SOW line items I plan to include: 8h dev for PoP integration, 16h ops for network & tunnel setup, audit retention addon ($2k/mo), optional Dedicated capacity line item if high QPS. Will put hourly rates in draft.

Avery (Legal): Note: I'll add PoP and attestation language to the SOW. We need to specify acceptance criteria for the POC (PoP verification, rotation test with zero-downtime, audit log delivery) and liability limits for key handling.

Jordan: Action items: Maya 14 confirm feasibility + sample config by EOD. Priya 14 confirm attestation verification steps + compliance checklist by EOD. Luca 14 draft SOW with line items and ballparks by tomorrow. Avery (Legal) 14 draft attestation/PoP clause.

Maya: ack :white_check_mark:
Priya: ack, pulling vendor attestation templates now :mag:
Luca: drafting SOW now
Jordan: thanks team :thumbsup:
